Wi-Tek WK-PS219GF 16FE+2GE+1SFP 180W 100Mbps PoE Switch Price in Bangladesh


The Wi-Tek WK-PS219GF 16FE+2GE+1SFP 180W 100Mbps PoE Switch is a high-performance unmanaged PoE switch designed for CCTV surveillance and professional networking solutions. With 16 Fast Ethernet PoE ports, 2 Gigabit uplink ports, and 1 Gigabit SFP slot, this switch ensures stable power supply and reliable data transmission for IP cameras, wireless access points, and VoIP devices.

Ideal for medium to large CCTV installations in Bangladesh, this 180W PoE switch supports extended transmission up to 250 meters and includes intelligent PD Alive (Watchdog) functionality for automatic device reboot.

Key Features


  • 16× 10/100Mbps PoE Ports (IEEE 802.3af/at)
  • 1× Hi-PoE Port (Up to 60W) for PTZ Cameras
  • 2× 10/100/1000Mbps Gigabit RJ45 Uplink Ports
  • 1× Gigabit SFP Port for Fiber Connectivity
  • 180W Total PoE Power Budget
  • Extend Mode up to 250m (10Mbps)
  • VLAN & Port Isolation Mode
  • PD Alive / Watchdog Function
  • Unmanaged Plug & Play Operation
  • Durable Metal Housing
